desc: Pax River is the headquarters of Naval Air Systems Command and the Navy's principal aviation research, development, test and evaluation centre; its FOIA reading room became the official repository for the Gimbal and GoFast UAP videos in 2020. In January 2026 Liberation Times reported that an exotic vehicle of unknown origin has been stored at the base for decades, that sources declined to describe it or say where it was found, and that contingency plans may exist to relocate it if the location were publicly identified. The reporting notes that NAVAIR Program Executive Offices manage the contracts through which analysis and exploitation work would run, and that the supporting contractor ecosystem has included Lockheed Martin and MITRE. Elizondo, in written testimony to Congress, placed Pax River among the sites prepared in connection with the blocked Lockheed Martin - Bigelow transfer, alleging a hangar designed to move material by air and by river. The board records this as tier-2 reporting resting on unnamed sources, with the Elizondo written-testimony element as its strongest anchor.
